title: The Setting From Last Time: What a Station Keeps Between Runs, What It Reads Back, and Files Written by an Older Version

questions.question: A settings file says robot/port=abc. What does QSettings::value("robot/port").toInt() give?
options: 0, and with no ok flag nothing says it was wrong
questions.explanation: The port abc was 0 with ok false.

questions.question: What type does a number have when QSettings reads it fresh from an INI file?
options: QString: an INI file keeps text
questions.explanation: The stored number was a QString.

questions.question: A speed limit in the file is 99 and the allowed range is 0 to 5. What does the station use?
options: 5, with a note that it was pulled to the end

questions.question: When is a setting in the file?
options: As soon as setValue is called
When it is synced: until then it is in memory, and a killed station has kept nothing
questions.explanation: Before save() the file did not exist.

questions.question: Why is the migration done only once?
options: Starting again would convert 1.5 m/s as if it were millimetres, giving 0.0015
questions.explanation: The version number, written after the migration, is how it knows.

questions.question: A value is missing from the file. Is it a problem?
options: No: it is the default, and a note is for a value that is there and wrong
questions.explanation: An empty file had no notes.
